scope: Independent display-boundary check for Arkansas in the 2022 election edition
officialSourceDescription: Four congressional districts enacted by Arkansas Act 1116 on October 13, 2021.
method: Compare Census generalized display polygons with independent official Arkansas enacted-plan polygons in equal-area EPSG:5070; measure intersection over union for matching district numbers and area overlap with other numbered districts.
interpretation: All four district numbers correspond to the enacted plan at display scale. Same-number area overlap is 97.8% to 99.4%; overlap with each other numbered district is below 0.8% of the Census district area.
limitations: This compares actual polygons with the state plan rather than relying only on release dates. It does not certify exact split-block locations or legal boundaries, and generalized shorelines differ. The exact Arkansas correction is not separately localized by this display-scale check; use detailed state geometry for legal-boundary questions.
